text:
What happens when a protostar becomes a stable star?
A
Most of the hydrogen is converted to helium and the protostar expands.
B
The inward force due to gravity is balanced by an outward force due to the high temperature.
C
The protostar collapses due to gravity and the temperature increases.
D
The protostar runs out of hydrogen as fuel for the nuclear reaction.
